== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|They needed to hold out a little longer—buy enough time for their partner to gain control of the cannon. They knew this dance all too well, and it was always exhilarating.}}

== Acquisition ==
=== Sold by ===
* In order to be able to purchase the {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} piece, the [[Ardent Glorious Breastplate (skin)|Ardent Glorious Breastplate skin]] or [[Glorious Hero's Breastplate]] must have been unlocked. Additionally, a [[PvP Rank]] of 100 is required.
{{Sold by|id = 89151}}

{{contained in|id=89151}}

== Used in ==
* The {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} version of this armor piece can be upgraded to {{rarity|legendary|legendary}} with the following recipe:
{{recipe

| source = mystic forge

| ingredient1 = 1 Mistforged Glorious Hero's Breastplate#item1
| ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Competitive Prosperity
| ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Competitive Prowess
| ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Competitive Dedication
}}
